      AI/ML Engineer III – Baazi Games

      Location: Delhi NCR | Hybrid

      Experience: 5+ years


      About the Role

      We are looking for an AI/ML Engineer III to join our engineering team and work on building, scaling, and deploying AI/ML solutions for our products. The role requires strong hands-on engineering skills along with the ability to take AI solutions from experimentation to production.


      What You'll Do

      • Design, develop, and deploy production-grade AI/ML solutions.
      • Work on Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, and AI-powered applications.
      • Build and optimize ML pipelines and AI services for scalability and reliability.
      • Work with Python and modern AI/ML frameworks and libraries.
      • Develop solutions involving LLM integration, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, and retrieval systems.
      • Design and implement RAG pipelines using vector databases and relevant retrieval techniques.
      • Experiment with different models, evaluate their performance, and optimize solutions for production use cases.
      • Build APIs and backend services to integrate AI/ML capabilities into products.
      • Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to translate business problems into scalable AI solutions.
      • Monitor, debug, and continuously improve AI/ML systems in production.
      • Contribute to technical architecture, code reviews, and engineering best practices.
      • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical decision-making.


      What We're Looking For

      • 5+ years of experience in AI/ML, Machine Learning Engineering, or a related field.
      • Strong programming skills in Python.
      • Strong understanding of Machine Learning and Deep Learning concepts.
      • Hands-on experience with LLMs, Generative AI, and RAG.
      • Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar.
      • Experience working with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant, FAISS, or similar.
      • Good understanding of embeddings, semantic search, retrieval, chunking, reranking, and prompt engineering.
      • Experience building and deploying AI/ML applications in production.
      • Strong understanding of REST APIs, microservices, and backend development.
      • Experience with Docker and AWS/cloud environments.
      • Good understanding of ML model evaluation, performance optimization, and monitoring.
      • Strong problem-solving and system-design skills.


      Good to Have

      • Experience with Agentic AI / AI Agents.
      • Experience with LangGraph or multi-agent architectures.
      • Experience with Fine-tuning, LoRA/PEFT, or model adaptation.
      • Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers.
      • Experience with Redis, Kafka, or other distributed systems.
      • Experience working with high-scale consumer products, gaming, fintech, or real-time systems.


      Key Skills

      Python | Machine Learning | Deep Learning | GenAI | LLM | RAG | LangChain | LangGraph | LlamaIndex | Vector Databases | Embeddings | Prompt Engineering | AI Agents | PyTorch | Hugging Face | FastAPI | Docker | AWS

        Mid-Senior level

      • Employment type

        Full-time

      • Industries
